scope: Matched 2025-S2 country comparisons within household energy category, selected sample only

pairs.note: Two distinct delivered energy products, not substitutable; cross-commodity ratio not an energy burden or welfare measure

methodology: Derived only from existing country-specific price observations; no newly fetched countries or historical data.
All ratios are descriptive nominal price ratios for identical commodity, consumer class, period and EUR/100 kWh unit.
Tax, consumption band and national purchasing-power differences remain; no affordability, geopolitical influence or causal inference.
Household electricity and household natural gas in Hungary shown side-by-side, not divided into cross-fuel burden or profit estimates.
Country-level 2025-S1 and national monthly HICP not yet available, so no national real change calculation.
